title: Hanasato Minori — MORE MORE JUMP!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's start again from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure! Um... Yikes, the wind's so strong!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh, yeah. It makes it difficult to hear anything.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This wind is nothing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When you're performing on an outdoor stage, sometimes you have to keep singing in a torrential rainstorm, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Gosh, really?
In that case we'd better toughen up by practicing in this weather!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Something just got blown over?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A flyer for a gig or some other show?
Minori, it's coming at you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? Yikes, got to dodge that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Blarg!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The wind changed direction and the flyer flew right back.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, you really have the worst of luck.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Get it off me!
I can't see anything!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't flail your arms and I'll take it off you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Phew... That wasn't pleasant.
Thanks for helping me, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: With things flying around, someone could get hurt. Why don't we take a break until the wind dies down a bit?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We don't have any shows scheduled, so there's no need to push ourselves so hard to practice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Speaking of shows!
There's something I wanted to ask you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How do you deal with anxiety before a show or some other big event?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I even get stressed out before auditions.
If you have any tips, that'll be great.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You get stressed easily, Minori?
I'd have never guessed.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? Minori always goes full steam ahead, so I could tell she wasn't the type to relax before shows.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Minori's the type to get so worked up, it makes her panic and get all clumsy, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What, you read me like an open book! This is why I was always doomed at sports events in elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Airi
rows.Line: (I knew it...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It makes me even more stressed to think that I might get so nervous that I'll make a mistake even after lots of rehearsals...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to help but... I don't think I've ever experienced stage fright.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What, seriously?! W-Wow!
So you never worry that you might slip up and embarrass yourself?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The only thing we have control over is how much we practice, so if I feel I've practiced enough, I leave it at that and I don't worry about what might happen.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, that's not going to be of any help to Minori!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, listen. You must not be afraid of failure!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyone can make a mistake, no matter how much they've practiced. And when that happens...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You just act unfazed and say something along, Huh? That wasn't right? I don't know what you're talking
about.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's an option?! I... I don't think I could do this. I'd be so self-conscious, I wouldn't be able to just gloss over a mistake.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've got to strengthen your psyche!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's easier said than done.
I think she's better off following my approach and practicing lots.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... Shizuku, and what do you do to stay calm?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm... I try not to think about having an audience until the show starts.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's hard not to get a little anxious when you know there are so many pairs of eyes on you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see... That method I can try right away!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, but, in your case, you might benefit more from paying close attention to the audience.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wouldn't it motivate you more to see all those people you want to entertain, to hear them cheering you on?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, that's some good advice! I can picture Minori getting really motivated by seeing our expectant audience!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. Out of all of us, Minori has the most idol potential.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? M-Me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, the wind seems to have died down.
Would you like to get back to practice?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure. We've had a long break.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's pick up from where we stopped.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wait! Can someone first explain to me what you meant about me having the most idol potential? Hey!
